Name: Head, lift and a short drive
Subsystem: SetHeadAngle, SetLiftHeight, DriveWheels and the robot's own action acknowledgements
Purpose: The first check where he moves under his own power, and the floor under every movement test after it. It is deliberately small: if the head and lift do not go where they are told, nothing about docking or navigation can be interpreted.
ExpectedTelemetry: a MotorActionAck for each commanded move and a checked stop at the end
ExpectedPhysical: The head tilts down and back, the lift rises and lowers, then he drives forward a few centimetres and back, and stops. Nothing keeps moving afterwards.
Prerequisites: a clear, flat surface with no drop at the edge
BlockedReason: D (Lift position readout) has not run yet, and MOV depends on it
